message.content: The reproduction confirms the cache grows past capacity because existing truthy keys skip eviction; falsy values also take the wrong branch. I’m correcting membership detection and always moving set keys to the newest end before enforcing capacity.

function.name: bash
function.arguments:
{"command":"python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('tinydb/utils.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    def set(self, key: K, value: V):
        if self.cache.get(key):
            self.cache[key] = value

            # Check, if the cache is full and we have to remove old items
            # If the queue is of unlimited size, self.capacity is NaN and
            # x > NaN is always False in Python and the cache won't be cleared.
            if self.capacity is not None and self.length > self.capacity:
                self.cache.popitem(last=False)
        else:
            self.cache[key] = value
            self.cache.move_to_end(key, last=True)
'''
new = '''    def set(self, key: K, value: V):
        self.cache[key] = value
        self.cache.move_to_end(key, last=True)

        # Check, if the cache is full and we have to remove old items
        # If the queue is of unlimited size, self.capacity is NaN and
        # x > NaN is always False in Python and the cache won't be cleared.
        if self.capacity is not None and self.length > self.capacity:
            self.cache.popitem(last=False)
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('target function not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

p = Path('tests/test_utils.py')
s = p.read_text()
needle = '''def test_lru_cache_set_update():
    cache = LRUCache(capacity=3)
    cache["a"] = 1
    cache["a"] = 2

    assert cache["a"] == 2
'''
replacement = needle + '''

def test_lru_cache_set_existing_key_moves_to_end():
    cache = LRUCache(capacity=3)
    cache["a"] = 1
    cache["b"] = 2
    cache["c"] = 3
    cache["a"] = 4
    cache["d"] = 5

    assert cache.lru == ["c", "a", "d"]
    assert "b" not in cache


def test_lru_cache_set_falsy_existing_value_moves_to_end():
    cache = LRUCache(capacity=3)
    cache["a"] = 0
    cache["b"] = 2
    cache["c"] = 3
    cache["a"] = 1

    assert cache.lru == ["b", "c", "a"]
'''
if needle not in s:
    raise SystemExit('test anchor not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(needle, replacement))
PY
python -m pytest tests/test_utils.py -q"}
